title: Decide the style first by specifying mood, colors, camera, pacing, and…
content:
Decide the style first by specifying mood, colors, camera, pacing, and reference materials before generating in Seedance 2.5.  
Use Flova Agent to convert a simple idea into a script and storyboard before starting Seedance generation.  
Review the Prompt Draft, then generate the video step by step using the appropriate model (e.g., Seedance 2.0 vs Seedance 2.5 vs MiniMax H3) for each stage/shot.  
Leave comments to correct anything that’s off-style, then save the generated assets or the entire workflow for reuse.
